mainEntity.name: Can it import both Excel and PDF WPSs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — both, natively. One parser reads Excel WPS workbooks; another reconstructs a PDF form's ruled grid and reads its cells. Either way, process, materials, positions, ranges and pass-by-pass parameters land as structured, searchable fields rather than a flat scan.

mainEntity.name: Do I have to re-type my procedures into a template?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. WPS Manager reads the documents you already have instead of making you conform to its format. A folder of existing WPSs becomes structured records without hand data entry.

mainEntity.name: Does it read Portuguese WPS forms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The built-in profile understands English and Portuguese layouts as shipped, so a PT or mixed EN/PT form imports without special setup. Further languages and shop-specific vocabularies are added through the same language-pack mechanism during onboarding.

mainEntity.name: What happens when a form leaves heat input blank?

acceptedAnswer.text: The app computes it from the arc parameters (current × voltage × 60 ÷ travel speed × process efficiency, per EN 1011-1) and flags it for you to confirm against the PQR. It is never a silent number.

mainEntity.name: Can I import many WPSs at once?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Batch import brings in a whole stack in one pass, and each file is classified as a new WPS, a new revision, or a correction as it lands, so revisions group correctly from the start.

mainEntity.name: Will it read my company's specific form?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard ISO 15609-style forms work immediately. Your exact layout is tuned during onboarding: you send a few real WPSs, we confirm the parser reads them and adjust if needed, and only then do you go live — handled in strict confidence.
